Eat your carrots, you'll see in the dark! Except, that was a war trick.
Did you believe it? Yes or no? Comment.
Nineteen forty. Britain turns off its lights at night, so bombers can't find the cities.
Yet one pilot keeps finding planes in the dark. They call him Cat's Eyes.

text: His real secret? A brand new radar in his plane.
To hide it, posters told everyone: carrots help you see in the blackout.

Historians think the enemy wasn't fooled. But everyone else was.
The true part: carrots give you vitamin A, and too little of it can cause night blindness.

text: But if you already get enough, extra carrots won't give you night vision.
So, did you believe it? Yes or no?
